camilladsp.feature_policy: build the pinned CamillaDSP package with its upstream default feature set, matching RoomEQ's required-backend CI rather than a reduced no-default-features build
camilladsp.dependency_lock_policy: upstream pin has no Cargo.lock; CI generates one from the exact pinned Cargo.toml, records its SHA-256 and retains it as evidence, then builds with --locked

truth_boundary: A green lane proves only the selected deterministic RoomEQ-export-to-real-CamillaDSP software PCM contracts and Aurora role-aware 7.1.4 WAV channel sentinel at the exact pinned source revisions. CamillaDSP is built with the upstream default feature set used by RoomEQ's own required-backend CI. CamillaDSP's pinned source does not publish Cargo.lock, so the generated lock and its SHA-256 are run evidence rather than an upstream dependency pin. This lane does not prove arbitrary DSP graphs, unsupported FIR crossover export, physical DAC or speaker wiring, amplifier or loudspeaker headroom, room acoustics, listening preference, measured end-to-end latency, protected-service interoperability, or any Dolby/DTS/HDMI certification claim. Unsupported graph semantics must be rejected rather than silently dropped.
